svg.title: The MolDeTr input contract
svg.desc: A proton NMR window of at most 1200 Hz is resampled at 5.12 points per Hz to 6144 real-valued finite points, then min-max normalised. The contract is field-independent: 80 to 600 MHz spectra all map to the same 1200 Hz window, because MolDeTr works in hertz.
svg.text: Field-independent — 80–600 MHz all map to 1200 Hz (MolDeTr works in Hz)
